title: Manager- PPC lead
description:
Manager- PPC lead Lead PPC activities for DCMF Plant operates efficiently and effectively, by optimizing resources, 1. Internal Stakeholders minimizing waste, and maximizing efficiency. 2. External Stakeholders 
 Responsibilities 1.Developing production schedules: To study the drawings, methods plan, quality plan and accordingly do the production planning and production schedules based on customer orders, resource availability, shop capability and production capacity. They must ensure that schedules are realistic, achievable, and balanced. 2.Estimate the cost of manufacturing for proposals and maintain the same cost during the execution. 3.Plan outsourcing and in-housework content. 4.Accurately control the time scheduled and keep the back up plans ready to ensure, on time delivery. 5.Prepare and provide the material kit lists to shop feeder cell with help of look ahead planning. 6.Generate and control the workstation plans. 7.Plan special process in-factory outsourcing. 8.Estimation of overloads and argument the resources like human resource, space, machines, tools. 9.Generate standard operating procedures. 10.Generate the plan vs actual data. 11.Minimise the project inventory. 12.Organize the Third-party inspection/ customer calls with help of QAC. 13.Support the project managers in their activities. 14.Digital Monitoring of production processes: monitoring production processes data to ensure that they are operating efficiently and effectively. Identify/ predict bottlenecks and other issues that may impact delivery by production and take corrective action as necessary. 15.Plan logistics. 16.Ensure the completeness of dispatches of equipment 
 Requirements Educational Qualification: B Tech Mechanical OR Diploma 1.Fabrication 1.Responsibility 2.Sub Contracting and Vendor development 2.Business Acumen 3.Project Planning 3.SAP / ERP and Data base understanding 4.Industrial engineering 4.Confict Management 5.Knowledge of manufacturing process of Lean and Mass Manufacturing and result orientated 5. Agility personality. 1. Developing and Establish standardized processes that can improve efficiency and reduce costs. 2. High analytical abilities 1. Uptodate Knowledge and experience in Internationals codes / standards like ASME ,API/EN/TEMA/ASTM 3. High Ownership 2. Very good Social and Communication skills along with attitude of Customer Orientation. 4. MS office, prima vera, AutoCAD, SAP5. Close collaboration among design, engineering, fabrication, and Quality teams to ensure Equipments meet quality, safety, and performance standards 
 Primary Skills 1. Manager-level understanding and ownership of PPC activities.
 2. SAP awareness/working knowledge.
 3. Team management experience is mandatory.
 4. Chassis manufacturing experience as discussed.
 5. Fabrication exposure skid and piping fabrication, gas cutting, etc.; relevant mass-production experience can also be considered.
 6. Experience managing in-house fabrication overload.
 7. Primavera P6 preferred; if not, strong hands-on Excel experience is mandatory.
 8. Routing, material kitting, workstation loading, baseline schedules, earned progress, plan-vs-actual and dispatch forecasting. 
 B.Tech Mechanical Engineering or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering Mangalore - Location General Shift 6 days

Key Skills: Team management,PPC,Management,Team,SAP
